text:
Maria Gomez: Quick check — flagged a 404 from an old KB link in onboarding flow: https://kb.redwood.ai/infra/instance-types -> returns 404. @Ben Liu any idea who owns KB pages under /infra?

docs-bot: [automated scan] Redirect/404 anomaly detected for /infra/instance-types (scan id: scan-1849007).

TJ Nguyen: I can take a look, might be under platform docs ownership after the reorg.

Ben Liu: Not my area anymore. Last owner handoff was Q4 — @Kate Ramos should own infra/runtime now.

Kate Ramos: I do own the infra/runtime section. I'll triage this.

Maria Gomez: Thanks Kate! If it's just missing redirect we can add a 301 -> /platform/instances. Can someone run a quick curl to confirm headers?

Ben Liu: Quick test to run locally:```bash
curl -I https://kb.redwood.ai/infra/instance-types
```

Ben Liu: I ran that — got 200? Actually got 404 body and no Location header, so no redirect configured.

Kate Ramos: OK I'll add a redirect rule in the next docs deploy. ETA: today EOD.

Noah Patel: If you want I can also update the CDN edge redirect map after your change, avoids a second downtime window.

Maria Gomez: EOD works. Please ping here when deployed so I can update the onboarding flow if needed. Also please re-run the zap scan.

docs-bot: Re-scan scheduled and queued for 1849008200.

TJ Nguyen: Small follow-up — we should grep internal onboarding code for hardcoded /infra links and update to /platform/instances to prevent future 3xx churn.

Kate Ramos: Good call. I'll search and open a PR for any matches.

Ben Liu: :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone — I'll mark KB-4123 as in-progress and close once docs-bot confirms the fix. Link to task: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/KB-4123

Kate Ramos: Deployed redirect and updated a couple of internal links. Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/892

docs-bot: Re-scan complete. No redirect/404 anomalies found for /infra/instance-types. (scan id: scan-1849008)

Maria Gomez: Confirmed. Closing KB-4123. Appreciated!
